name: Tunwal E-Motors Ltd
about: Incorporated in December 2018, Tunwal E-Motors Limited specializes in designing, developing, manufacturing, and distributing electric two-wheelers.[1]
keyPoints: Business Profile[1] The company has over 23 different scooter models under 6 variants

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 212% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 33.3%
cons: Earnings include an other income of Rs.6.09 Cr.
Debtor days have increased from 27.5 to 45.2 days.
Working capital days have increased from 72.8 days to 145 days
